tips_en: Start with Paper 1 (ModularRSI) for its clean modular decomposition framework and strong empirical results showing how benchmark-disjoint, contrastive evolution enables effective recursive self-improvement of agent harnesses across multiple models. Papers 1 and 2 are thematically linked—both dissect mechanisms of iterative model/harness improvement, with Paper 2 isolating a specific failure mode (length inflation) in another self-improvement loop (on-policy distillation). Paper 3 stands apart as an evaluation-focused study on multimodal physical reasoning, offering a useful contrast to the agent-coding focus of Paper 1.
tips_zh: 建议首先阅读论文1（ModularRSI），其模块化解耦框架清晰，且实证结果有力，展示了如何通过基准无关的对比式进化实现智能体harness跨多个模型的有效递归自我改进。论文1与论文2主题相关——都剖析迭代改进机制，论文2则聚焦于另一种自我改进循环（on-policy蒸馏）中的特定失效模式（长度膨胀）。论文3则独立于前两篇，作为一项聚焦评估的研究，探讨多模态模型对物理世界的推理能力，与论文1的智能体编码焦点形成有益对比。
